verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack with the logo, headline and CTA in proportion and readable. Its one flaw is that the group sits high, so the bottom ~40% of the 300x600 canvas is empty particles and the vertical balance is off. B shrinks the SOLSTICE logo until it can't be read and blows the headline and CTA up to almost the same huge size, which ruins the hierarchy. B's CTA also wraps into three lines with 'Line' left alone on the last one, and the type is jammed against the side and bottom edges.
